sloka: ततो दानवदर्पघ्नं सौमित्रिं देवकण्टकः ।तं पीडयित्वा बाहुभ्यामप्रभुर्लङ्घने ऽभवत् ।अथैवं वैष्णवं भागं मानुषं देहमास्थितम् ।। ६.५९.११३ ।।।।
transliteration: tato dānavadarpaghnaṁ saumitriṁ devakaṇṭakaḥ ।taṁ pīḍayitvā bāhubhyāmaprabhurlaṅghane 'bhavat ।athaivaṁ vaiṣṇavaṁ bhāgaṁ mānuṣaṁ dehamāsthitam ।। 6.59.113 ।।।।

translations.english: Even though Saumithri was wounded in the chest and the power of Brahma entered (into his chest) he recalled himself as an inconceivable form of Vishnu.
